user_prompt: Our engineering team keeps pushing through design changes that require updates to our IT infrastructure, but we're struggling to keep pace with manual coordination across multiple systems. Right now, when a new component specification comes through, we have to manually track which servers need reconfiguration, which licenses need reallocation, and which hardware needs to be deployed—and it's creating delays and tracking errors. We need a way to automate this entire workflow so that when engineering changes are approved, all the downstream IT infrastructure changes happen consistently and in the right sequence.

args.content:
LANDSCAPE INVENTORY:
- corp.itsm: IT service management (incident analysis, asset provisioning) - INTERNAL focus
- sap.ariba: Procurement/supply chain
- sap.s4: ERP
- siemens.plm: PLM systems (BOM compliance, engineering change coordination)
- sap.ehs: Safety/EHS - HAS SAFETY COMPLIANCE AUTOMATION FOR ENGINEERING CHANGES & MATERIALS
- workday.hcm: HR/HCM
- sap.sf: SuccessFactors - workforce planning
- emarsys.cx: CX/engagement (marketing campaigns, vendor engagement orchestration)
- my.mes: MES (manufacturing execution)
- sap.crm: Sales/CRM (opportunity qualification, sales compensation)
- sap.odm: Entity type taxonomy

KEY FINDINGS:
- SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator (sap.ehs) = primary resource for automating safety validation on engineering changes + materials before production
- BOMComplianceValidator (siemens.plm) = BOM-specific compliance validation complementary resource
- EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning (siemens.plm) = handles coordination side
- AssetProvisioningOrchestrator (corp.itsm) = PRIMARY FOR IT INFRASTRUCTURE AUTOMATION - monitors engineering changes and orchestrates asset/equipment allocation, material provisioning, and infrastructure coordination in real-time

CONFIRMED GAP:
No customer issue tracking, case management, or support ticketing system in landscape.

args.reason: Automates IT infrastructure coordination (server reconfiguration, license allocation, hardware deployment) triggered by engineering changes, orchestrating provisioning workflows in real-time with consistent sequencing.
